floorAtlasPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production GAME FLOOR TEXTURE ATLAS, a precise 2 by 2 grid of four equally sized square top-down seamless material tiles. Every quadrant touches its neighbours with NO borders, gaps, text, labels, characters, objects, shadows or perspective. Soft hand-painted dark fantasy game art, simplified material shapes and restrained contrast. Each quadrant is a different independent seamless tile: TOP LEFT Cindervault, black basalt flagstones with muted ember orange seams and fine ash; TOP RIGHT Thalassar, pale pearlescent tessellated shell stone with restrained turquoise seams; BOTTOM LEFT Vespera, deep indigo velvet-like dream marble with soft violet swirls; BOTTOM RIGHT Hourglass Expanse, weathered warm sandstone and small bronze inlay, faint drifting sand. Flat evenly lit top-down materials, no directional light, no walls, no scenery. Texture edges should tile without conspicuous dark grid lines. Square canvas.

realms.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A brand-new production fantasy GAME ARENA BACKDROP for CINDERVAULT, an ash-buried industrial empire whose armies emerge from living furnaces. Extremely wide panoramic 4:1 landscape composition, environment only. Painted polished card-game art with bold readable architectural shapes, subtle cel shading and soft distant contrast. Across the skyline: immense black basalt KILNS and blocky iron foundry citadels, rows of smoking chimneys, enormous glowing furnace doors, lava channels and suspended chain bridges, ash dunes beneath deep rust-colored smoke. Make the central landmark a colossal squat industrial furnace with four tall smokestacks and one orange fire door, not a palace. Restrained charcoal/iron/rust palette with warm orange seams. All important architecture in the middle vertical band; a narrow calm flat horizon along the bottom, no large foreground fighting platform. NO floating crowns, NO crowns of any kind, NO gothic cathedral, NO royal palace, NO people or creatures, NO UI/text/logos/labels/borders. Fill the canvas, no padding or blurred strips. Distinctive heavy industrial fantasy, rather than a fallen-star kingdom.
